in_sanskrit.name: साईकिरण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name SaiKiran is derived from the Sanskrit words 'साई' (sāī) meaning 'God' and 'किरण' (kirana) meaning 'ray of light' or 'shining ray'. Thus, the name SaiKiran can be interpreted as 'God's Ray of Light' or 'Shining Ray of God'.

This name is often associated with the Hindu deity Sai Baba, who is believed to protect and guide his devotees.
